## Crystal Dragon, Very Young (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 CG Small dragon (earth)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +9

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +5 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 70 (5d12+10)  
 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +8, **Will** +5  
 **Immune** paralysis, sleep, sonic  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)  
 **Melee** bite +8 (1d6+1), 2 claws +7 (1d4+1)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (20-ft. cone, 4d4 sonic, DC 14)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 5th; concentration +9)  

  At will—*[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 15)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 13, **Dex** 14, **Con** 15, **Int** 12, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 18  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 17 (21 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Deceitful, Lightning Reflexes, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Bluff +14, Climb +17, Disguise +11, Fly +12, Intimidate +12, Perception +9, Stealth +14; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Climb  
 **Languages** Draconic, Undercommon  
 **SQ** razor sharp  

**Special Abilities**

 **Razor Sharp (Sp)**  All of a crystal dragon’s natural attacks deal slashing damage.  

  
  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground (Plane of Earth)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
